text:
Claire: Tiny poll: who wants office karaoke Friday? yes/no (one-word replies)

Noah: yes

Irene: no (but I will judge)

Liam: yes if there are backup mics

bot-snacks: :microphone: Karaoke tally: 2 yes, 1 no, 1 judge pending snack supply.

Claire: one-liner warmup: give me a two-word stage name. I'll start: Snack Whisperer.

Noah: Keyboard King.

Irene: Mood Maestro.

Liam: Power Chords.

Claire: Also quick haiku challenge while we plan songs: 5-7-5 about snacks. shortest wins.

Noah: "Bagel on my desk / little crumbs plan escape routes / coffee watches on"

Irene: "Sticky note lover / label saves the lonely lunch / fridge peace restored"

Liam: "Leftover mystery / fridge hums a guilty whisper / jam waits quietly"

bot-snacks: :trophy: Crowd favorite haiku: Noah's bagel saga. Prize: one coffee coupon.

Claire: Logistics: karaoke starts 6pm if we have at least one volunteer DJ. volunteers?

Noah: DJ Noah, reporting for duty.

Irene: I will bring glowsticks for moral support.

Liam: I'll handle sound checks. also napkins.

Claire: perfect. final one-liner: "Bring jam, not drama."

bot-snacks: :sparkles: Event pinned. See you Friday. Thread closed.
